notice: These are local software records and planning units. They are not money, deposits, securities, cryptocurrency, guaranteed revenue, or proof of legal ownership.

project.name: Alien Radio
project.creationIconMeaning: Open the editable creation portal, version history, conversion plan, and ancestry. It is not a favorite button.

tokenTypes.name: Product Token
tokenTypes.purpose: A typed claim or production plan for the exact product or service the Infinity system needs.
tokenTypes.mintRule: Created from an approved, capacity-backed product plan.

tokenTypes.name: Star Blueprint
tokenTypes.purpose: The editable, attributable, reversible creation record for Alien Radio or another station design.
tokenTypes.mintRule: Created when a user saves a named version of a station or product design.

tokenTypes.name: Radio Star Coin
tokenTypes.purpose: A station-sharing participation record collected in addition to the existing Alien Radio listening tokens.
tokenTypes.mintRule: One Radio Star Coin is created on each 10th confirmed station-share action after the per-station cooldown.
tokenTypes.listenerTokenRelationship: Additive. Listening tokens continue under the existing radio wallet rules and are not replaced.

tokenTypes.name: Avatar Coin
tokenTypes.purpose: A station-identity activation unit locked to one operating radio-station identity.
tokenTypes.mintRule: One Avatar Coin is produced when another verified user actively uses the creator's station design for 24 continuous qualified hours.
tokenTypes.stationRequirement: One locked Avatar Coin per active radio-station identity.

tokenTypes.name: Infinity Unit
tokenTypes.purpose: General settlement and transfer unit handled by the wider Infinity clearing system.
tokenTypes.mintRule: Not issued by Alien Radio Token Studio.

alienRadioSeed.creator: Kris
alienRadioSeed.name: Alien Radio Star Blueprint
alienRadioSeed.product: A complete AI-assisted radio station identity, channel system, research engine, creator world, and Avatar Coin production path.
